content: Zentelmi Tita hi Paul-ih rawngbawlnak ruangih zumtu ih cang mi a si men thei (1:4). Anih cu Antiok le Jerusalem ah Paul thawn an thlunaw dah (Gal 2:1-3). Anih hi Paul in Galatia ramṭhen pál in a vei khatnak missionary khual a tlawn laiah a tel ding ti zum a si. Paul ih missionary khualtlawn a vei thumnak khalah a tel ih, Korinth khua ih thubuai tifel dingah Paul ih a hril mi a si ( 2Korinth Thuhmaihruai siar aw). Tita-ih hmin hi 2Korinth sungah vei tampi a lang (2:13; 7:6, 13-15; 8:6, 16, 23; 12:18). Cumi in amah hi nun dik nei mi le rawngbawlnak ah rintlak a si ti a langter. Cuvek minung a si ruangah Khirit kawhhran pitlingter dingah Paul in a hril hi mangbang ding a um lo (Tit 1:5).

Mediterranean Tifinriat ih Khirit tikulh kaupi hi Rom in a rak uk mi a si. Hi tikulh ih mipawl hi nuncan lam le tlanlendān lamah an hmin a rak sia (1:12), asinan thuthangṭha cun an nun a thleng. Khirit mipawl in Pentikos ni ah Peter ih thusim mi an ngainak ihsin an hnenah thuthangṭha a rak thleng thăwk a si men thei (Apo 2:11). Hi tikulh hi Paul in thawngtla dinhmun in Rom khawpi a pan tikah a pál phah (Apo 27:7-13). Rom ralkappawl in Paul an thlah hnuah (1Timothy Thuhmaihruai siar aw), Tita thawn Khirit ah a tlawngsal. Cumi ṭum ah rei deuh a cam a bang. Khirit a suahsăn tikah cutawk ih rawngbawlnak hlĕnsuak dingin Tita a ruat (1:5). Paul in Efesa le Masidonia a tlawn hnuah Tita hnenah, a hrangih lamhmuhtu ah, cakuat a ngan. Cuih kum cu A.D. 65 hrawng a si.

Tita cakuat hin thurin dik thawn milawin hna ṭha kan ṭuan ih, nundān dikin kan nun le kan tlanlēn theinak dingah, Khrih in in rundam thu in zirh. Sikhalsehla cumi dawnkhamtu thil pathum Paul in a buaipi, cupawl cu zirhnak diklo, Pathian ngaihsaklonak le leitlun câkhiarnak tla an si. Dawnkhamtu a pakhatnak cu bung khatnak ah a buaipi ih, a tling mi elder-pawl nĕmhngeh a pawimawhzia a sim. Bung 2-3 ah dawnkhamtu dang pahnih thu a buaipi ih, kawhhran sungih zumtupawl cu an kum izirih kăwmdan ding le pehtlaihdān ding pawl a rel.
Pathian zangfahnak in rundamnak ah in hruai ih, sual nehdān le hnaṭuan ṭha hrangih ṭhahnemngaidān ding thupawl in zirh (2:11-14).
